judgement.reason: Memos supports PostgreSQL via MEMOS_DRIVER and S3 for attachments, so contained changes (VERSION default, frontend build step, local storage) make it run.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /var/opt/memos (scripts/Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: The shown lines do not prove that a setting moves every file in /var/opt/memos, such as uploaded attachments, to PostgreSQL or S3, and the README says everything Memos keeps is in that folder.
